children: DERAYAH FINANCIAL COMPANY - TO INVEST SAR 244 MILLION IN HOF CAPITAL STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITIES FUND II
DERAYAH FINANCIAL - 40% OF COMMITMENT, SAR 97.5 MILLION WAS CALLED UPON THE TRANSACTION CLOSING ON 28 AUGUST 2026
DERAYAH FINANCIAL - REMAINING 60% IS EXPECTED TO BE DRAWN OVER THE FOLLOWING 24 MONTHS
DERAYAH FINANCIAL - TRANSACTION WILL BE FINANCED THROUGH CO'S OWN RESOURCES AND AVAILABLE CREDIT FACILITIES
DERAYAH FINANCIAL - INTENDS TO LAUNCH A MULTI-STRATEGY FUND FOCUSED ON AI AND TECHNOLOGY
DERAYAH FINANCIAL - UPON LAUNCH, CO INTENDS TO TRANSFER ITS INVESTMENT IN FUND, TO NEW FUND, WHICH WILL BE MANAGED BY CO'S ASSET MANAGEMENT TEAM
DERAYAH FINANCIAL - TRANSACTION EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE POSITIVELY TO CO'S ASSET MANAGEMENT BUSINESS THROUGH SUBSCRIPTION AND MANAGEMENT FEE INCOME
